common_condition: Rev17 implementation 0.4.1; STM32F103 at 72 MHz; F4; PLI 0.20; no added noise; seed 1000; 8000 samples; 50-sample blocks
deterministic_repeat_finding: Within each firmware image, all three author-provided UART captures are byte-identical. Additional repetitions of the same image are therefore not expected to add timing information under this no-interrupt deterministic benchmark.
next_boundary_selection_rule: Use the frozen full host matrix to select conditions that change scheduler activity or expose an A3-versus-B4 quality boundary; do not add repetitions solely to inflate n.
